title: Fence unfinished prompt-owned Claude foreground calls after their turn's terminal result
outcome: A current-runtime Attempt foreground call without a correlated tool end remains a hazard after Idle or Error, so fresh peer checks cannot gain credit until that call reports its end.
acceptance: A foreground Bash entry owned by a host prompt remains hazardous after that prompt's success or error result when no correlated tool_result arrived, even if runtime and turn generation are unchanged; checks begun afterward in an overlapping workspace are fenced.
Only a correlated completion releases the current restriction, stored check fences remain sticky, and ordinary active prompt-owned foreground work retains its existing writer-overlap behavior.

Deterministic production-frame regressions cover terminal success/error before tool_result and a fresh peer check afterward; the final input passes focused tests, the full gate and the independent review pair.
